challenge/pmc_ai_weapon_extract_detail_d:
We need to acquire intel about how Al-Qatala is arming its grunts. Bring back some of their weapons so we can analyze them.

Extract ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 Enemy grunt weapons.
challenge/pmc_capture_sam_site_detail_de:
Al-Qatala has set up several surface-to-air missile sites in the DMZ. There are frequently transport planes flying overhead, SAM sites can shoot them down allowing you to recover their supplies.

Capture ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 SAM sites.
challenge/pmc_cash_extract_detail_desc:
We are low on coin because of several consecutive botched operations by your fellow soldiers. We need a lump sum urgently for an upcoming mission.

Extract ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 cash in one match.
challenge/pmc_charlie725_extract_detail_:
Uncle Sam is looking to do some research on the weapons being distributed throughout Al Mazrah. Acquire and extract a Hail Storm shotgun and we can use it to gain some goodwill with the feds. 

There's a rumor the Hail Storm can be purchased at specific buy stations.

Extract a Hail Storm.
challenge/pmc_extract_weapon_case_desc: Kill a boss and extract their weapon case.
challenge/pmc_extract_weapon_case_detail:
We've received intel that the chemist has acquired a weapon case containing valuable rare weapons. Find a hard drive and upload it in order to track him down. Acquire his weapon case by any means necessary.

Kill a boss and extract their weapon case.
challenge/pmc_full_backpack_extract_deta: While we recover from the recent attacks, our infiltrations and extractions from the AO will be limited. Recover enough items to fill your backpack and make it worth the risk.
challenge/pmc_gas_drain_detail_desc:
Al-Qatala is planning to transport weapons using civilian vehicles, drive nearby vehicles until their tanks are empty to sabotage Al-Qatala's plans.

Empty ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 vehicles of gas.
challenge/pmc_grenade_extract_desc: Extract with ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 different lethals or tacticals.
challenge/pmc_grenade_extract_detail_des: Extract with ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 different lethals or tacticals.
challenge/pmc_hydro_shotgun_ai_desc: Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 grunts in hydro using a shotgun.
challenge/pmc_hydro_shotgun_ai_detail_de:
Travel to Hydro and get up close to the Al-Qatala infantry so we can observe their tactics. Dispatch them with a shotgun. You can acquire one in a buy station or in an Enemy supply cache.

Travel to Hydro ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 Time.
Kill ^.&&2^7 grunts in hydro using a shotgun.
challenge/pmc_kill_riot_shield_detail_de:
Enemy strongholds are often guarded by well equipped grunts with riot shields. If you can outflank them you'll have easy access to the loot they're protecting.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 riot shield grunts.
challenge/pmc_kill_tier3_detail_desc:
Heavily armored grunts will infil if you cause enough trouble in the DMZ. We need intel on their combat capabilities, get their attention and terminate them.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 armored grunts.
challenge/pmc_liquor_extract_detail_desc:
Before Al Mazrah was evacuated, a famous collector of fine liquors lived there. Looters have stolen and relocated most of his collection all around Al Mazrah. Find a few bottles and bring them back, they're highly valuable.

Extract ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 liquor bottles.
challenge/pmc_long_range_kill_detail_des:
Good marksmen can take out enemies before they're ever detected. Prove your marksmanship by eliminating some Al-Qatala grunts from long range.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 grunts at long range.
challenge/pmc_oilfield_sniper_ai_desc: Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 grunts in oilfield using a sniper rifle.
challenge/pmc_oilfield_sniper_ai_detail_:
The Oilfields are a critical POI for our operation. Wipe out the grunts there, but don't get too close. Acquire a sniper rifle at a buy station or elsewhere and use it to eliminate the hostiles.

Travel to Oilfield ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 Time.
Kill ^.&&2^7 grunts in oilfield using a sniper rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_ar_desc: Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operators with an assault rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_ar_detail_de:
Prove that you have the skills to be a helpful asset to us. Acquire an assault rifle and use it to terminate other operators.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operators with an assault rifle.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_detail_desc:
We need to increase our influence in Al Mazrah. Eliminate any operators you find to strengthen our foothold.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operators.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_exhume_detai:
Command wants to get a foothold in Quarry, but informants have told us about rampant activity from other Factions. Clear out some of their operators so we can move in.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operators in Quarry.
challenge/pmc_operator_kill_smg_detail_d:
Weapons found in the DMZ are unreliable. Verify the killing potential of a recovered SMG by testing it on hostile operators.

Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operators with an SMG.
challenge/pmc_pistol_headshot_desc: Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 grunts with headshots using a pistol.
challenge/pmc_pistol_headshot_detail_des: Kill ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 grunts with headshots using a pistol.
challenge/pmc_poi_travel_desc: Travel to ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 different Points of Interest (POIs) in one deployment.
challenge/pmc_poi_travel_detail_desc: Al-Qatala has taken over our area of occupation and we need to understand their command structure to know where to hit them. Recon multiple sectors in the area and we'll observe how their network operates.
challenge/pmc_tag_extract_detail_desc:
We need proof of Enemy faction presence in the DMZ to get approval for higher troop deployments. Tech will run a background check on the operator and pay you a lump sum for each dog tag extracted.

Extract ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 operator dog tags.
challenge/pmc_task_elimination_detail_de:
Al-Qatala has stationed several high value targets in Al Mazrah. Intercept their communications to track them down and eliminate them.

Complete ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 elimination contracts.
challenge/pmc_task_hunt_detail_desc:
You can intercept Enemy communications in order to find the location of hostile Faction operators. Use this intel to eliminate Enemy squads.

Complete ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 hunt contracts.
challenge/pmc_uav_tower_detail_desc: AQ is using UAV Towers to recon the area. Gaining access to these towers is a priority for Signals Intellience. Your primary objective is to locate a UAV Tower, access the controls, and reroute the signal.
challenge/pmc_uav_tower_single_detail_de: Al-Qatala has deployed UAV towers at many points of interest around the DMZ. These towers provide critical intel on the surrounding areas. Activate them and route the signal to base so we can gain an informational advantage.
challenge/pmc_unique_vehicle_pilot_desc: Enter ^?#x02b125210c0b2bb1.#x0cf5c0139ba6f896c^&&1^7 different vehicle types in one match.

challenge/pmc_vehicle_destruction_detail: Transport is scarce in Al Mazrah, so AQ is commandeering all vehicles in the area. We need you to limit their movement capabilities for an upcoming operation. Locate and destroy any vehicles you find.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Free^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^: The observer fully controls the Aerial Camera's position.

jup_weapon/golf36_desc: Chambered in 5.56, this assault rifle offers exceptional range and reliability for most engagements.
levels/backstabbed_desc: Ghost, Soap, Rudy, and Alejandro’s Los Vaqueros pursue Hassan under the cartel's protection. Mexican Army troops in the pocket of the cartel intervene.
levels/border_desc: Laswell tasks Alejandro to stop Hassan from crossing the border.
levels/convoy_chase_desc: Price and Gaz enlist some old friends to help rescue Laswell from AQ.
levels/gunship_ambush_desc: Graves and the ground team fight cartel reinforcements to keep Hassan secure.
levels/gunship_compound_desc: Ghost, Soap and Alejandro search a cartel controlled compound for Hassan, supported by Graves and his Shadow Co from an AC130 overhead.
levels/intercept_desc: With Laswell on overwatch, Price and Gaz infiltrate a cartel smuggling operation off the coast of Spain in search of enemy missiles.
levels/marina_desc: With Laswells help, Price and Gaz pursue an AQ cell in Amsterdam and discover an unholy alliance.
levels/montage_desc: In Amsterdam, Gaz, Price and Laswell use CIA tactics to roll up an HVT in broad daylight.
levels/nightwar_desc: Ghost and Soap lead the MARSOC marines on a mission to kill or capture terrorist leader Major Hassan Zyani.
levels/party_desc: Soap, Alejandro, Ghost and Graves hatch a plan to infiltrate the home of a Las Almas cartel lieutenant in search of the elusive El Sin Nombre.
levels/prison_desc: Rudy, Soap and Ghost break into a Shadow Co black site prison to extract Alejandro and the Los Vaqueros.
levels/shadowbase_desc: TF-141 and Los Vaqueros go on a rogue mission against their own.
levels/shipaf_desc: Soap, Alejandro, Ghost, Graves and his Shadow Co race to an offshore oil platform to prevent an imminent strike on US soil.
levels/stolen_desc: Laswell uncovers intel regarding a stolen shipment of American missiles.
levels/strike_desc: On a recon mission in Al Mazrah, Ghost, Shepherd, Laswell and Shadow Co take out a high value target.
levels/tower_desc: TF-141 deploys with the MARSOC marines to prevent an attack on an American city.
levels/wounded_desc: Alone, unarmed and hunted, Soap must improvise to survive.
levels_jup/cp_jup_apt_desc: Price and Gaz assault a Konni safehouse in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
levels_jup/cp_jup_chemical_desc: 141 assaults Konni forces at a nuclear power plant in Northern Urzikstan.
levels_jup/cp_jup_dam_desc: Soap and Ghost engage Konni forces at Gora Dam to prevent a false flag attack.
levels_jup/cp_jup_port_desc: Farah and the ULF prepare to receive a secret arms shipment at a port in Urzikstan.
levels_jup/cp_jup_ranch_desc: Farah races to the site of a crashed Russian Airliner to protect the ULF from being framed.

Set the minimum time in milliseconds between consecutive mouse wheel inputs before another signal is sent.

Low values will make it easier to trigger an action twice in quick succession if it is bound to the mouse wheel. This can also make it more likely to accidentally trigger the action more times than intended.

^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^Unlimited:^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^ Frame rates are tied to your computer's performance.

[{ui_font_net_latency_high}] ^?#x0df01504d5eb8601e.#x02f30da4ea89649a^High Latency:^?#x0d0fc60310d4a2ef9.#x0871f5414ac580f9^ Internet speed is affected. Close any other running app or active download (orange: 100-149 ms, red: 150-250+ ms).

vehicles/apc_desc: This amphibious APC can lay down 30mm cannon fire, transport up to 6 squad members to the front line, and serves as a mobile spawn point.
vehicles/atv_desc: Take charge with rough and ready capability delivered with plenty of low-rpm torque and power. Top-tier rack capacity offers an impressive payload capability: hold 'er wide and send it.
vehicles/c130_desc: A heavy assault gunship equipped with a laser tracking missile, along with the standard 40mm and 25mm cannons.
vehicles/cargo_truck_desc: A large industrial vehicle. Slow moving, but may provide a small amount of protection in firefights.
vehicles/jeep_desc: Built and designed without compromise, a spacious interior allows for crew transportation to even the most remote corners of the map. Confident on- or off-road, with the durability to tackle the most extreme of challenges, the SUV can take a beating and keep on ticking.
vehicles/light_tank_desc: A maneuverable tank with a multipurpose turret and light armor.
vehicles/little_bird_desc: A twin-engine light helicopter for combat support and rapid traversal of the engagement zone.
vehicles/tac_rover_desc: The pinnacle of ultra-light tactical off-road vehicles, allowing rapid personnel deployment for squads of up to four. Go deep and hard in the most rugged and austere environments with world-class mobility and versatility.
vehicles/vehicle_horn_mountainking: In the Hall of the Mountain King

ZM_SAT_INTEL/AQUA_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "When an empire falls, a better one rises from the ashes. This is how society has always evolved. But now it's time for a leap in evolution. The Guild offers a better way. A better life for those who don't stand in the way of progress." - Emma Kagan
ZM_SAT_INTEL/ARIES_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Frank really stepped up after my dad died. I don't know what I would have done... or who I'd have become without him. Now he needs my help, but he's pulling away. I can't let him to go through this alone." - David Mason

ZM_SAT_INTEL/CANCER_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Of all the CIA's dirty secrets — and there are many — the Cradle is my favorite. First tested on William Calderon, I believe the CIA failed to grasp the toxin's potential. See, Emma's vision needed a catalyst. And the moment I found that sample, I knew I had it."
ZM_SAT_INTEL/CAPRICORN_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Even the best laid plans can hit a snag. That's why I recruit the best of the best: a team that can improvise, making the impossible possible. Specter teams know exactly when to trigger plan B — like an EMP blast to save their lives." - Troy Marshall

ZM_SAT_INTEL/GEMINI_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Fishing. One of the few happy memories with dad when he was alive. I wonder what he'd say if he could see me now. I thought I knew once — that he'd say he was proud. Now I'm not so sure." - David Mason
ZM_SAT_INTEL/LEO_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Menendez gave himself completely to Cordis Die. He was a monster convinced he was the hero. Convinced he was doing the right thing. But he was insane. I feel like I'm losing my mind here. Am I still doing what's right? Or am I becoming like him?" - David Mason
ZM_SAT_INTEL/LIBRA_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Fear is an opportunity. You either accept it, or you're swallowed by it. The only way past it, is through it. And it's hard, real fucking hard, to conquer it. But what waits on the other side is worth everything. Freedom." - David Mason
ZM_SAT_INTEL/PISCES_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "The Guild's used their influence to create a media blackout about their operations on Avalon. It will be impossible to win the hearts and minds of the people without hard facts. And even then, some won't believe us. We need enough evidence to rid the people of any doubt." - Troy Marshall
ZM_SAT_INTEL/SAG_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Priya Zaveri. The Guild's highest ranking marksmen, and the highest paid. She does it for the money, and for Emma Kagan. I'd say we should have hired her, but you can't trust people like that." - Chloe "Karma" Lynch
ZM_SAT_INTEL/TAURUS_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "To Emma, the Cradle isn't a bioweapon. It's hope. Collateral damage in exchange for a better world. Yeah, there's money in it. But Emma can pull the trigger in a way nobody else can." -  Slade "Razor" Barrick
ZM_SAT_INTEL/VIRGO_ARTIFACT_1_DESC: "Leilani makes every second count. I chose her for the team for her resiliency and precision. The bionic limbs give her an edge in combat, sure, but she didn't have them when I chose her. Her heart keeps her grounded, and the team's better for it."  - Troy Marshall
